appUrl.description: URL of the app, taken from the primary ingress, eg `https://app.example.com/`. Points to `127.0.0.1` when there is no ingress.

podCIDR.description: CIDR of the pods, taken from `global.podCIDR`. Falls back to `172.16.0.0/16`.

svcCIDR.description: CIDR of the services, taken from `global.svcCIDR`. Falls back to `172.17.0.0/16`.

items.description: Host and port of a service.

internalUrls.description: Internal URLs of the services of the chart, filled in by common and shown in the notes.

description: Details about the release that common works out on every render, for use in Helm `tpl` strings such as `{{ .Values.chartContext.appUrl }}`. Common sets these keys itself and replaces values set here.
